scientific_integrity: Exact backward-equation proof; standalone finite residual and independent Brownian-bridge simulation checks. The first-passage time distribution and mean of the motivating model are prior work. Historical priority and scientific results have not undergone independent external review.
scientific_limitations: Strictly positive Brownian diffusivity, reset rate, gate-switch rates and reset coordinate; particle-only Poisson resetting and perfectly transparent inactivity. Single spatial dimension. Results concern eventual first-active-capture side, not joint arrival time and side. Fast-gating limit is singular for the approach-side observable and is not a continuous-target side law.
title: Exact side-of-arrival law for a transparent blinking Brownian target
